messages:
🎉 Barcelona · Sat 28 Nov
Sun: Cazzu (Argentine trap) at Razzmatazz is sold out; her second date is Mon 30. Barça play away Sun 16:15, and it is general-election day.

TODAY · Sat 28 Nov

1. Carolina Durante — Fin de la aventura
🕘 Tonight 19:00–21:00 (listings differ) · 📍 Palau Sant Jordi
📊 Arena show at Palau Sant Jordi, tickets still on sale on Fever
💶 From €38
💬 Spain's biggest indie-punk band closing their album tour in the arena: thousands, a loud local sing-along crowd. Sources disagree on the start time, so go by the ticket.
https://feverup.com/m/398962/en

2. Catupecu Machu
🕘 Tonight, doors 20:00, show 21:00 · 📍 Razzmatazz 2 (entrance C/ Pamplona 88)
📊 Razzmatazz's own agenda: on sale, not sold out; mid-size room
💶 €32.50 + fees
💬 Argentine rock veterans from Buenos Aires, so the crowd will be largely Argentine. Expect several hundred in Razz's second room; tickets were still available on the venue site today.
https://www.salarazzmatazz.com/en/agenda/28-11-2026-catupecu-machu/

3. SOUNDIT Plaza: Joy Orbison, Aurora Halal, TRS, EYRA
🕘 Today 16:00 → 22:00 · 📍 Plaza Monumental de Barcelona
📊 2,043 interested on RA · RA Pick · also on DICE
💶 18€, 22€, 25€, 28€, 32€
💬 Daytime rave in the old bullring with Joy Orbison headlining; the biggest electronic crowd of the day, expect a couple of thousand. Also featured in @planesenbarcelona's weekend round-up. Starts at 16:00.
https://ra.co/events/2480242

4. Adam Beyer presents Drumcode - Hivernacle Barcelona
🕘 Tonight 22:00 → 04:00 · 📍 Plaza Mayor de El Poble Espanyol
📊 1,687 interested on RA
💬 Adam Beyer's Drumcode takes the Poble Espanyol square for Hivernacle's season closing. Big-room techno, expect well over a thousand; the late option if you skip the afternoon.
https://ra.co/events/2554309

5. El Tardet — Saturday tardeo
🕘 Today 17:30 → 23:00 · 📍 Sutton, C/ Tuset 32
📊 Weekly Saturday session in YouBarcelona's tardeo guide
💶 Guest list via YouBarcelona
💬 The regular Saturday tardeo at Sutton: commercial hits, dressed-up local crowd, done by eleven. It fills weekly, but I found no listing naming today's date, so check the guest list before going.
https://youbarcelona.com/es/p/tardeo-barcelona-sabados

TOMORROW · Sun 29 Nov

1. Grecas
🕘 Sun 21:00 · 📍 Sant Jordi Club
📊 4,600-capacity hall; venue site shows tickets on sale
💶 From €39.70
💬 The biggest concert in town on Sunday: general-admission floor at Sant Jordi Club, so a crowd in the thousands. Tickets were still on sale on the venue's page today.
https://palausantjordi.barcelona/en/grecas

2. CHURROS CON CHOCOLATE - 80's
🕘 Sun 16:00 → 05:00 · 📍 SALA APOLO
📊 no public headcount (DICE doesn't publish one)
💶 €19.51
💬 The long-running Sunday party at Apolo, 80s edition: pop hits, drag shows, very mixed and friendly crowd from 16:00. It regularly fills the main room (well over a thousand) and Apolo is pushing it in its December programme.
https://dice.fm/event/8e97g7-churros-con-chocolate-80s-29th-nov-sala-apolo-barcelona-tickets

3. SOCIAL LAB X BUS HEXPERIENCE
🕘 Sun 12:00 → 22:00 · 📍 BUS Hexperience
📊 202 interested on RA
💬 All-day vinyl session on the BUS terrace: house DJs, food and a sociable daytime crowd, expect a couple of hundred coming and going. Easy one to drop into with friends in the afternoon.
https://ra.co/events/2585477

4. Salsa & Latin Vibes
🕘 Sun 18:00 → 22:00 · 📍 La Paloma
📊 #1 of 18 on Xceed by popularity · venue has 64 followers on Xceed
💶 €13.50–95
💬 Live salsa band plus DJ in La Paloma's old ballroom, the top-ranked Sunday event on Xceed. A dancing crowd of a few hundred, locals and Latin Americans; early finish at 22:00.
https://xceed.me/en/barcelona/event/salsa-latin-vibes-75/251363

Scanned: RA 63 · DICE 27 · Xceed 18 · Eventbrite 164 · Luma 4 · Instagram 27 posts + 16 stories (partial). Not available today: Meetup (every request failed).
